docs.summary: A reference to one agent type in the project's table (see [`NavMeshAgentTypes`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAgentTypes)), by its persistent id. The default is [`Humanoid`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAgentTypes~Humanoid). Converts to and from the id; the type is what gives a field the agent type dropdown in the inspector.
The type's display name, or "Agent Type N" when the id is no longer defined.
